welcome_subtitle: Together, let's fight waste for a sustainable future.
about_us_text: No More Waste is an association dedicated to fighting food and material waste. We believe in a world where resources are used responsibly and sustainably.
activity_1_text: We organize collections of surplus food and materials to redistribute them to those in need.
activity_2_text: We offer to redistribute surplus food to those in need.
activity_3_text: We work with companies and other organizations to promote sustainable practices.
testimonial_1: No More Waste has changed my life by helping to reduce waste in my community.
testimonial_2: Thanks to No More Waste, I have been able to help those who need it most.
cta_title: Join us in the fight against waste
cta_text: Become a volunteer and be part of the solution.
